name: Jalal Khan
summary: Senior Full Stack Engineer with 8+ years of experience designing and delivering scalable SaaS platforms across EdTech, home energy, and logistics sectors. Expert in Next.js, React, Angular, TypeScript, Node.js, Go, and Python, backed by deep AWS cloud-native infrastructure experience including Lambda, ECS/EKS, Bedrock, and SQS. Proven track record leading engineering teams, architecting microservice systems, and integrating AI/LLM features — including RAG pipelines, conversational chatbots, and NL2SQL engines — that drive measurable business outcomes. Experienced across the full delivery lifecycle from system design and API architecture to CI/CD, containerization, and production observability.

experience.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
bullets: Led a cross-functional team of 4 engineers (2 frontend, 2 backend) delivering SaaS platforms for the home energy and EdTech sectors, driving code reviews, sprint planning, and architectural decisions
Architected Go and Next.js microservices for a home energy SaaS platform, enabling modular, independently deployable services with clean REST and GraphQL API boundaries
Built a customer-facing AI chatbot using Mistral 3B and LangChain serving 30,000+ students, reducing HelpScout support tickets by ~70% through conversational self-service
Implemented a natural language-to-SQL engine enabling non-technical users to query structured databases conversationally, eliminating dependency on manual reporting
Implemented document summarization pipelines using AWS Bedrock Knowledge Bases and RAG architecture, automating instructor evaluation review at scale
Integrated event-driven messaging with Amazon SQS to enable asynchronous, decoupled communication across microservices
Built serverless infrastructure with AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and Cognito for high availability and zero-downtime deployments across multi-tenant applications serving 30K+ concurrent users
Implemented secure authentication using JWT, OAuth 2.0, and AWS Cognito with role-based access control across SaaS products
Automated CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and GitLab CI, streamlining build, test, and deployment workflows
Optimized React frontend performance using memoization patterns and enforced WCAG accessibility and responsive UI standards

experience.title: Full Stack Developer
bullets: Designed and delivered full-stack features for logistics and home services platforms (HVAC, insulation, solar) using Angular, NgRx, and TypeScript, building responsive, component-driven enterprise UIs
Built scalable backend services with Node.js (NestJS) and PostgreSQL, focusing on modularity and long-term maintainability across multi-service architectures
Developed Python-based AWS Lambda functions to automate XLSX report generation, contract creation, and email delivery, eliminating manual back-office workflows
Integrated Amazon SQS for asynchronous job processing across service workflows, improving fault tolerance and decoupling service dependencies
Designed and optimized MongoDB and PostgreSQL schemas for high-throughput services, implementing Redis caching strategies to reduce database load on frequently accessed endpoints
Dockerized microservices and deployed to AWS ECS/EKS, improving environment consistency across development, staging, and production
Implemented CI/CD pipelines with GitLab CI, streamlining release cycles and reducing manual deployment overhead
Contributed to AWS infrastructure (Lambda, EC2, S3) and established monitoring and alerting using CloudWatch and Sentry
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to define technical specs and ensure delivery aligned with business goals

experience.title: Frontend Developer
bullets: Designed and maintained responsive, accessible UIs for applications using React and Typescript to with a component-based architecture.
Integrated REST APIs with Redux for efficient state management and supported debugging, unit testing, and UI validation across critical modules.
Optimized component rendering and virtual DOM updates, improving page load times and overall application responsiveness.
Implemented dynamic forms, tables, and interactive dashboards, handling complex state and user input with Redux Toolkit and context APIs.
Refactored legacy JavaScript code into modern React functional components with hooks, improving maintainability and code readability.
Collaborated on state management architecture for large applications, balancing Redux, Recoil, and context-based solutions.
Ensured cross-browser compatibility, mobile responsiveness, and WCAG accessibility compliance for stable, client-ready experiences.
Integrated REST APIs using Redux for state management and supported debugging and UI testing across key modules.
Participated in Agile sprints, peer code reviews, and delivery processes using Webpack, Git, and Jira.
Built a strong frontend foundation while exploring full-stack concepts, setting the stage for backend and cloud development.

education.institution: National University of Science and Technology
